newsitem.title: UK: Lowe Group to take stake in GGK Occidental.
newsitem.headline: Lowe Group to take stake in GGK Occidental.

text.p: Lowe Group on Wednesday said it agreed to take a substantial minority interest in the GGK Occidental advertising agency, which will open opportunities for Lowe in central and eastern Europe.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Lowe, a unit of Interpublic Group of Cos Inc, said the GGK Occidental holding company will be renamed Lowe GGK.
Vienna-based GGK has 16 offices in nine central and eastern European countries and annual billings in excess of $180 million.

With over 300 million sophisticated consumers and a very healthy double-digit growth in advertising expenditure, central and eastern Europe is clearly a major growth opportunity, Lowe Group chairman Frank Lowe said in a statement.
